facts.fact: The finance minister told the National Assembly that 93 local authorities had so far been connected to the Government Wide Area Network, in a paragraph that counts 116 councils (93 of 116), alongside 79 district administration offices and 29 schools, 438 sites cumulatively.
The budget address says Government continued to roll out the Government Wide Area Network to public institutions and had connected 93 local authorities to it.
The budget address gives the purpose of connecting 93 local authorities to the Government Wide Area Network only as improving public service delivery; no use is named.
The finance minister describes the roll-out of the Government Wide Area Network to local authorities as Government's own.

systems.tiers: 93 local authorities, 79 district administration offices, 29 schools; 438 sites cumulatively
